        gold = inst["gold"]

        oracle_f1s.append(max(sample_f1s))
        random_f1s.append(float(np.mean(sample_f1s)))

        sj_scores = compute_sample_sj_scores(inst, subtask)
        fk_scores, key_sets = compute_sample_surface_scores(inst, subtask)
        vc_scores = compute_sample_voting_conf(key_sets, N)
        em_scores = compute_sample_em_scores(key_sets)
        lp_scores = compute_sample_logprobs(inst)

        all_scores = {"SJ": sj_scores, "FK": fk_scores, "VC": vc_scores,
                      "EM": em_scores, "LP": lp_scores}

        for sig in SIGNALS:
            chosen = int(np.argmax(all_scores[sig]))
            signal_f1s[sig].append(sample_f1s[chosen])

    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    print(f"  Computed in {elapsed:.1f}s")

    greedy_arr = np.array(greedy_f1s)
    oracle_arr = np.array(oracle_f1s)
    random_arr = np.array(random_f1s)

        "n_instances": n_inst,

            "selection_f1": round(float(arr.mean()), 5),
            "delta_vs_greedy": round(float(arr.mean() - greedy_arr.mean()), 5),
            "bootstrap_p": round(boot["p_value"], 5),

        }

    return result

SCALE ABLATION: LLaMA-3.2-3B vs LLaMA-3.1-8B — SciERC NER

=== 5-SIGNAL CORRELATION (Spearman rho) ===

FULL split (n=529, gold-empty=22 excluded):
Signal    8B rho   3B rho   delta    8B AUROC  3B AUROC
Voting    0.405    0.460   +0.055    0.697     0.743

LP        0.150    0.266   +0.116    0.532     0.633

CONDITIONAL split (greedy_f1 > 0):
Signal    8B rho   3B rho   delta    8B AUROC  3B AUROC
Voting    0.308    0.382   +0.074    0.671     0.722
SJ        0.272    0.345   +0.073    0.657     0.729
FK        0.147    0.213   +0.065    0.587     0.660
EM        0.317    0.395   +0.079    0.724     0.782
LP        0.081    0.210   +0.129    0.513     0.616

=== F1 METRICS ===
8B: greedy=0.646, oracle=0.775, headroom=+0.129
3B: greedy=0.627, oracle=0.763, headroom=+0.136

=== SELECTION F1 (single-seed, bootstrap N=10000) ===
Method      8B sel_F1  3B sel_F1
Greedy      0.646      0.627
SJ          0.638      0.633 (3B delta=+0.006, p=0.175)
FK          0.640      0.630 (3B delta=+0.003, p=0.337)
VC          0.640      0.611 (3B delta=-0.015, p=0.973)
EM          0.629      0.617 (3B delta=-0.009, p=0.912)
LP          0.648      0.628 (3B delta=+0.001, p=0.434)
Oracle      0.775      0.763

=== KEY FINDINGS ===
1. All 5 signals show HIGHER rho for 3B vs 8B (delta +0.03 to +0.13)
2. SJ > FK ordering preserved in both models (3B gap=0.108, 8B gap=0.074)
3. structural_beats_surface = True for both
4. LP rho shows largest improvement in 3B (+0.116 full, +0.129 cond)
5. Selection F1: SJ shows positive trend for 3B (+0.006) but not significant (p=0.175)
6. The "correlation-selection gap" persists: high rho but limited selection gain

Phase 3 全部完成。总结：

## LLaMA-3.2-3B SciERC NER — 结果

**训练**: 5 epochs, 585 steps, train_loss=0.091, eval_loss=0.116

**F1**: greedy=0.627 (8B: 0.646), oracle=0.763 (8B: 0.775)

**5-Signal ρ (FULL split)** — 3B 所有信号都高于 8B：

| Signal | 8B ρ | 3B ρ | Δ |

| VC | 0.405 | **0.460** | +0.055 |
| SJ | 0.310 | **0.375** | +0.066 |

| FK | 0.235 | **0.268** | +0.032 |

1. 小模型信号相关性更高（模型越弱，信号越 informative）
2. SJ > FK ordering 在两个 scale 都成立（3B gap=0.108 > 8B gap=0.074）
